run_download_model_en: run the download_model script to download pre-trained English word vectors from fastText
run_download_model_fr: run the download_model script with language fr to download French pre-trained vectors
run_download_model_overwrite: run the download_model script with --overwrite to replace existing model files
review_command_download: review the command_download function that wraps fasttext.util.download_model for downloading vectors
test_main: test the main function that parses language and overwrite arguments via argparse
